Recent findings all 54 entries

MEASURED Backstop + Diagnosis 2026-11-24

In an exploratory follow-up, dropping the blind N2 fallback (D_only: refuse a stop only when diagnose() produces a hint) preserved 100% of task-success gains across all three models while eliminating regressions at N=843/250 and cutting post-fork wrong actions by 73–79%, though gains remained uneven across families.

Key metricqwen2.5:7b D_only task pass vs N0 (exploratory): 0.389 vs 0.331 (49 rescued, 0 lost, Holm p = 0.0000) (328/843 vs 279/843 tasks (N=1,000: 395/1000, 56 rescued / 1 lost))

LimitProspective out-of-sample confirmation (D_only was designed from post-hoc G2 findings and evaluated on the same test sets, not unseen seeds).

Full table & evidence (#backstop-diagnosis-hint-only) · Ledger

NEGATIVE-RESULT Backstop + Diagnosis 2026-11-24

Exploratory cross-family testing showed artifact-only diagnosis is uneven across 7–9B model families and did not generalize over plain refusal on either gemma4:e4b (which already self-recovers on plain refusal) or ministral-3:8b (which failed to convert D's hints); an external tau2-bench smoke gate failed below a zero-tool floor and was dropped.

Key metricgemma4:e4b H1 recovery D vs N2 (exploratory): 0.467 vs 0.447 (Holm p = 0.3635, fails; oracle H = 0.489) (21/45 vs 21/47 turns (task pass +6.0 pp over N0, 15/0, but N2 already +5.6 pp))

LimitConfirmatory cross-family bounds (exploratory, N=250, single seed) or behavior on external benchmarks where small models clear a zero-tool floor.

Full table & evidence (#backstop-diagnosis-cross-family) · Ledger

NEGATIVE-RESULT Backstop + Diagnosis 2026-11-24

A preregistered artifact-only diagnosis (built from error text and tool schemas, zero ground truth) lifted qwen2.5:7b error recovery from 16.0% to 42.1% and whole-task success by +5.7 percentage points with clean G1, but failed the post-fork wrong-action guardrail G2 (registered verdict: Gain not clean).

Key metricH1 recovery D vs N2 (class-B refused turns): 0.421 vs 0.160 (lb 0.375 vs 0.24 floor, Holm p = 0.0001) (126/299 vs 44/275 turns (76.5% of oracle H gain))

LimitGeneralization across model families (failed H1 on ministral-3:8b and gemma4:e4b), transfer outside BFCL's eight simulated apps, or silent-failure coverage.
